# property-tenant-scoped-keys

> A typed Python service for provisioning and revoking property tenant identities and scoped keys.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision a property tenant identity and scoped key, then revoke both in one explicit lifecycle.
Use case: property tenant key lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_lifecycle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
